component.name: OpenNaga
component.summary: Remap the buttons of the Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed

description.p: OpenNaga gives every button of the Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed its own action: keyboard shortcuts, text, macros, media and system controls, apps, commands or a profile switch. It is an independent open source project, not affiliated with Razer.

ul.li: Profiles, with an optional profile per app
A Hypershift layer held on any button
DPI, polling rate and scroll sensitivity
Saving a profile to the mouse memory, with a backup of its original assignments
